name: Handles, Shooting & Contain
summary: Tighten your handle, shoot off a baseline drift, wall off drives, then finish with jumpers on tired legs.

drills.name: Freeze-Frame Dribbles
drills.summary: Stay in control at speed by stopping the ball dead on your own count.
steps: Pound dribble with your right hand at waist height.
Every fourth dribble, catch the ball and freeze it on your hip in triple threat.
Hold for one second, then rip back into the dribble.
Switch to your left hand after 45 seconds.
Finish with crossovers, freezing on the hip after every third cross.

drills.name: Baseline Drift Jumpers
drills.summary: Drift to the open spot when a teammate drives baseline, then catch and shoot.
steps: Put a cone on the wing as the driver. Start at the slot on the same side.
Picture the driver going baseline. Drift down to the corner with your hands ready.
Self-toss to your shooting pocket as you land in the corner.
Shoot on the catch with feet set. Grab your rebound.
Do 5 shots, then switch sides.

drills.name: Baseline Force Slides
drills.summary: Force the ball to the baseline and cut it off before the rim.
steps: Set one cone on the wing, one in the corner, one on the block.
Start in a stance at the wing cone with your top foot high to take away middle.
Slide hard to the corner cone without crossing your feet.
Drop step and slide to the block cone to cut off the baseline drive.
Sprint back to the wing and repeat. Switch sides at halftime.

drills.name: Elbow Sprint-Back Jumpers
drills.summary: Hit elbow jumpers on tired legs after every sprint to half court.
steps: Start at the right elbow with the ball.
Shoot a jumper and grab your rebound.
Dribble hard to half court and touch the line.
Sprint dribble back to the left elbow and shoot again.
Keep going, switching elbows each rep, until the timer ends. Count your makes.
